integration: Add pub mod interval_tree in src/core/mod.rs.
Init returns Option<Box<BlastIntervalTree>>; reset borrows &mut; free consumes Option<Box> and returns None.
Unsafe add takes NonNull<BlastHSP>, &mut tree, QueryInfo and EITreeIndexMethod::QueryAndSubject for standard gapped score. Unsafe contains takes &tree, &HSP, QueryInfo and min_diag_separation.
Unsafe query-only redundancy counting requires QueryOnly indexing. Default gapped-score containment uses QueryAndSubject.

Keep owning HSP Boxes alive until tree reset/free, including HSPs evicted/discarded by bounded HSP list insertion if their handles were already indexed. Moving/sorting Box handles is safe because referent addresses stay stable.

Changing query/subject coordinates, context or QueryInfo grouping while indexed invalidates the geometric key contract. Score/metric changes remain live reads; mutations must never overlap tree operations. Tree removal only unlinks nodes and does not free payloads.
Verifier must recognize pub unsafe fn source mappings; no unsafe Send/Sync implementation is provided.
